company: The Chinese University of Hong Kong
title: Research Assistant
highlights: 1st Research: Led a seven-member undergraduate team investigating the effects of placement and colour contrast on nested halftone QR codes to achieve higher information density while maintaining scan reliability. Developed a nested halftone QR code generator in Kotlin/JVM, enabling experiments with varied configurations, sizes, and error correction levels.

2nd Research: Optimised batch sizes and intermediate node buffer sizes to enhance transmission efficiency under the batched sparse codes (BATS) scheme. Developed a Python simulator to replicate wireless communication in multi-hop networks with BATS Codes as transmission method.
